messages.subject: DSM covariate specfication at odds with sample/subsample selection
parts:
Hi all

=20

A follow up DSM question! I now have my data in but can't get the model
to run.

=20

Quick recap - boat line transect data of birds. I want to fit a DSM
using depth and distance to coast as predictors.

Data is in 3 layers: transect, segment and observation.

=20

I seem to have a mismatch between sample (transect) and SubSample
(segment) which prevents me from using the MRDS model fitted at the
sample level to generate estimates at the segment level in DSM.=20

=20

When I try to fit a DSM model at the transect level (Unit to model:
Sample) I get an error telling me that it can't find the covariates,
which are within the segment layer. But if I try to run the model at the
segment level (Unit to model: SubSample) I get an error telling me that
effort has been recorded at the (higher) transect level so it can't be
calculated (I get the same error (about incalculable effort) if I try to
fit the MRDS model at the SubSample level).

=20

There is a length field in the segment subsample layer - do I need to
specify this somewhere in Distance so that can be used?

=20

Help please,

=20

Thanks

Mark=20
